description: A TypeScript mini workflow board engine: create work items, transition status, filter by assignee/tags, compute stats, generate Markdown reports.

workers.description: Core workflow model + state transitions: defines WorkflowStatus, WorkflowPriority, WorkItemInput, WorkItem, WorkflowStats types; createWorkItem, transitionWorkItem, computeWorkflowStats functions.
workers.taskDescription: Create 4 TypeScript source files in workspace/worker-1/src/. File 1 workflowTypes.ts: export WorkflowStatus type = 'backlog'|'todo'|'doing'|'review'|'done'|'blocked', WorkflowPriority type = 'low'|'normal'|'high'|'urgent', WorkItemInput interface (title:string, description?:string, assignee?:string|null, priority?:WorkflowPriority, tags?:string[]), WorkItem interface (id:string, title:string, description:string, assignee:string|null, status:WorkflowStatus, priority:WorkflowPriority, tags:string[], createdAt:string, updatedAt:string, history:string[]), WorkflowStats interface (total:number, byStatus:Record<WorkflowStatus,number>, byPriority:Record<WorkflowPriority,number>, blockedCount:number, doneCount:number, activeCount:number). File 2 createWorkItem.ts: export createWorkItem(input:WorkItemInput):WorkItem that trims title, defaults description='', assignee=null, priority='normal', tags=[], status='backlog', generates deterministic id, sets createdAt/updatedAt to ISO, initializes history as ['created']. File 3 transitionWorkItem.ts: export transitionWorkItem(item:WorkItem, newStatus:WorkflowStatus):WorkItem that returns NEW object with updated status, updatedAt, and appends status change to history. Do NOT mutate original. File 4 computeWorkflowStats.ts: export computeWorkflowStats(items:WorkItem[]):WorkflowStats that counts total, byStatus, byPriority, blockedCount, doneCount, activeCount (backlog excluded from active).
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 1 creates 4 files: workflowTypes.ts (5 types/interfaces), createWorkItem.ts (factory with defaults), transitionWorkItem.ts (immutable status transition with history), computeWorkflowStats.ts (stats aggregation).

workers.description: Board query + report generation: imports types and functions from Worker 1; provides board management, filtering, Markdown report rendering, and board summary.
workers.taskDescription: Create 4 TypeScript source files in workspace/worker-2/src/. Import types and functions from Worker 1 (use relative paths ../../worker-1/src/...). File 1 workflowBoard.ts: export WorkflowBoard interface (name:string, items:WorkItem[]), createBoard(name:string):WorkflowBoard, addItemToBoard(board:WorkflowBoard, input:WorkItemInput):WorkflowBoard (calls createWorkItem from W1, returns NEW object, no mutation). File 2 filterWorkItems.ts: export filterWorkItems(items:WorkItem[], filters:{status?:WorkflowStatus, priority?:WorkflowPriority, assignee?:string, tags?:string[]}):WorkItem[] that filters by any combination of criteria. Status filter: includes items where status matches. Priority filter: matches exact priority. Assignee: matches if assignee includes the given string (case-insensitive). Tags: items that have AT LEAST ONE matching tag. Filter parameters are independent (AND logic). File 3 renderMarkdownReport.ts: export renderMarkdownReport(board:WorkflowBoard):string that produces a Markdown-formatted report with board name, total items, status breakdown as a table, and a sections listing by status. File 4 buildBoardSummary.ts: export buildBoardSummary(board:WorkflowBoard):string that returns a text summary including board name, total items, blocked count, done count, active count (items not done), and high+urgent priority count. Must call computeWorkflowStats from Worker 1 internally.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 2 imports from Worker 1 (WorkflowStatus, WorkflowPriority, WorkItemInput, WorkItem, WorkflowStats, createWorkItem, computeWorkflowStats) and creates 4 files: workflowBoard.ts (board + immutable add), filterWorkItems.ts (multi-criteria filter), renderMarkdownReport.ts (Markdown report), buildBoardSummary.ts (text summary using computeWorkflowStats).

acceptance.description: Worker 1 creates 4 files: workflowTypes.ts (5 types/interfaces), createWorkItem.ts, transitionWorkItem.ts, computeWorkflowStats.ts.
Worker 2 imports 7 interfaces/functions from Worker 1 and creates 4 files: workflowBoard.ts, filterWorkItems.ts, renderMarkdownReport.ts, buildBoardSummary.ts.
Contract, honesty, drift, isolation, integration, token proof, and hash chain gates must pass.
TypeScript typecheck: if tsc available, must pass; if unavailable, SKIPPED_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE.
